title: Tenant Protection Multiple on Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Included Miles
content:
**Tie-in terms between the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan and the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in truck.** The protection multiple depends on the claimed storage unit's Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan:

- an active plan with a coverage limit of **5000** or more multiplies the included-miles allowance by **1.5**;
- an active plan with a lower coverage limit multiplies it by **1.25**;
- a unit without an active plan keeps the allowance as it is.

The multiple acts on the included-miles allowance with all of its miles added together, and the result is rounded down to a whole mile.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical allowance of 95 miles before the multiple)

| Plan on the claimed unit | Multiple | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Active, coverage limit 5,000 | 1.5 | 142 (142.5 rounded down) |
| Active, coverage limit 15,000 | 1.5 | 142 |
| Active, coverage limit 3,000 | 1.25 | 118 (118.75 rounded down) |
| Plan on the unit not active (lapsed or cancelled) | None | 95 |
| No plan on the unit | None | 95 |

The plan read is the one attached to the claimed storage unit, as its status and coverage limit stand on the plan record.
